_comment_encoding: Output is dimmer2048 (binary, 0x000-0x800), not the dimmer800 (BCD 0-800) the file name says: the Spartan-7 bitstream multiplies register 0x35 as plain binary and has never decoded BCD, so BCD made the backlight a staircase with ~5.5 % jumps at every BCD hundreds boundary (12.5, 25, ... 100 %). Measured 2026-10-11: binary is linear, ~12 nits per 1 %. The file keeps its name because micropanel's pi-config-txt links it by name.
_comment_variant: 14.6-inch FHD direct-drive panel (pi-config-txt type 14.6-fhd). Same Spartan-7 board, OPT4001 and dimmer800 output as config_fpga_opti4001_lux_dimmer800.json (12.3-NQ5, which keeps the shared dimmer800.csv) and config_fpga_opti4001_lux_dimmer800_14_6_ej.json (scan-mode EJ); only the brightness-to-nits curve differs, so only sweep_table does. calibrations/dimmer800_14_6_dd.csv is a REFERENCE (golden-sample) sweep of one direct-drive unit, 2026-10-11.
